findings.title: Oracle Critical Patch Update Advisory - October 2026
findings.summary_md: Oracle's October 2026 Critical Patch Update contains 1295 new security patches across Oracle product families and credits Horizon3.ai researchers Brandon Peterson, Jimi Sebree, and Noah King for CVE-2026-101767. The flaw is an unauthenticated SQL injection in the Oracle Application Object Library component of Oracle E-Business Suite affecting versions 12.2.3 through 12.2.15, and Oracle strongly recommends customers apply the Critical Patch Update security patches as soon as possible. Oracle notes prior Critical Patch Update advisories should be reviewed for earlier published security patches.

findings.title: CVE-2026-101767: Oracle EBS SQL Injection RCE
findings.summary_md: Horizon3.ai's attack research team discovered CVE-2026-101767, an unauthenticated SQL injection in the Thin Client Framework servlet of Oracle E-Business Suite's Application Object Library that executes SQL as the APPS database user and can be chained to operating system command execution as the EBS application account. The flaw carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8 and affects EBS versions 12.2.3 through 12.2.15. Horizon3 reported the issue to Oracle on July 24, 2026, and Oracle addressed it in the October 2026 Critical Patch Update released October 20, 2026, with indicators of compromise including unexpected files in the $APPLPTMP directory.
